amendment_reason: Exact-zero GT reference encountered in the frozen rank-4 [30 s, 60 s) excerpt; SI-SDR and BSS Eval SIR are undefined for that target.

amendment_timing.basis: Amendment was triggered by a mathematically undefined exact-zero target metric before any final downstream analysis, not by downstream result selection.

protocol_selection_basis: Protocol choices were fixed before official-test access and were not selected from development metric results.

dataset.name: MUSDB18-HQ
dataset.phase2_4_access_rule: Do not enumerate track names or read official-test audio during Phase 2.4.

track_selection.normalization: Unicode NFC applied to each exact official-test track directory name
algorithm: At the first Phase 2.5 execution, obtain all official-test track directory names without reading audio content.
Normalize every exact directory name to Unicode NFC and fail if normalization produces duplicate names.
For each normalized name, compute SHA256(UTF8("ELEC5305_PHASE2_TEST_5305|" + normalized_track_name)).
Sort by lowercase SHA-256 hexadecimal digest ascending; use normalized track name ascending only as an impossible-digest-collision tie-break.
Select the first 10 and freeze that generated manifest before inference or metric computation.
track_selection.blindness: independent of audio content, separation quality, downstream results, and random-number-generator implementation

excerpt.short_track_policy: Stop Phase 2.5 and report a protocol-amendment requirement if any selected track is shorter than 60 seconds; do not choose another segment automatically.

source_representation.renderer_input: one mono stem per virtual point source
source_representation.pre_metric_processing: no normalization, loudness matching, resampling, trimming, or automatic alignment

gain.scientific_metric_signals: raw floating-point signals before listening gain

reference_activity.energy_definition: reference_energy = sum(reference.^2) using the decoded mono float64 samples
reference_activity.active_rule: ACTIVE if and only if reference_energy > 0
reference_activity.inactive_rule: INACTIVE_REFERENCE if and only if reference_energy == 0

inactive_reference_policy.csv_representation: blank numeric fields with explicit reference_status and metric_status

source_metrics.macro_aggregation: unweighted arithmetic mean over ACTIVE reference stems only

sir.evaluation_scope: whole 30-second excerpt; one result per source
sir.active_subset_rule: Retain ACTIVE sources in canonical relative order and omit INACTIVE_REFERENCE targets only from metric computation, not from stored rows.
sir.identity_mapping: Each ACTIVE source maps to itself in canonical relative order.
sir.aggregation: unweighted arithmetic mean across ACTIVE whole-excerpt source SIR values
sir.permutation_requirement: returned permutation must be identity for the active subset

metrics.name: binaural SI-SDR
metrics.definition: Phase 2.3 zero-mean projection SI-SDR independently per ear

downstream_metrics.new_metric_policy: Do not add downstream metrics after Phase 2.4 unless a mathematical bug is found.

stft.boundary_policy: MATLAB spectrogram behavior used by the frozen Phase 2.3 implementation

analysis_plan.pseudo_replication_rule: Do not treat four stems times ten songs as forty independent downstream observations.

rq1.question: Does downstream error change with spatial condition?
rq1.design: Each song is one paired unit across colocated, moderate, and wide conditions.
rq1.reporting: Show all 10 paired song results plus condition mean, median, and variability without assuming an ordering in advance.

rq2.question: Does source-separation quality predict downstream spatial fidelity?
rq2.primary_sample: N=10 songs, including rank 4 whose source predictors average its three ACTIVE stems

supplementary_sensitivity.exclusion: rank 4 is excluded only from this supplementary sensitivity analysis
supplementary_sensitivity.design: 2 predictors x 3 outcomes x 2 primary conditions
supplementary_sensitivity.retention_rule: Retain and report regardless of whether correlations are stronger or weaker than the primary analysis.

rq2.reporting: Report Spearman rho and scatter plots; emphasize direction, magnitude, scatter, and consistency. Any p-value is descriptive only.

primary_figures: Figure A: downstream fidelity/error versus spatial condition with paired song points/lines and aggregate
Figure B: macro source SI-SDR versus downstream fidelity for moderate and wide
Figure C: macro SIR versus downstream fidelity for moderate and wide

interpretation.forbidden_claim: Do not interpret relative RMSE or other objective metrics as a perceptual degradation percentage.

readiness.status: AMENDMENT VALIDATION REQUIRED BEFORE PHASE 2.5 RESUME
readiness.basis: Protocol v1.1 preserves all frozen selections and definitions for ACTIVE sources while defining mathematically valid handling for the one exact-zero reference.
